name: bespunky-vscode-identity
description: Make every project's VSCode window recognizable at a glance, without Peacock's whole-window glow. `window-identity` picks a project-fitting emoji for the window title and a quiet bar colour derived from the design-system primary (else a stable name hash), written by the @bespunky/nx-tools:window-identity generator with a no-clobber ratchet. A SessionStart hook offers the upgrade to the brand colour once a design system appears.
